subject: Password reset not working
body: Hi support, I forgot my password and the reset link keeps saying it has expired. Can you help me get back into my account?

subject: Can't log in after changing password
body: I changed my password this morning but now I can't sign in. It says my credentials are incorrect.

subject: Locked out of my account
body: I've tried logging in a few times and my account is now locked. Please help me regain access.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hello, I noticed two charges for my subscription on my credit card statement this month. Could you check this?

subject: Invoice needed for last payment
body: Could you send me an invoice or receipt for my most recent subscription payment? I need it for my company expenses.

subject: Why did my subscription price change?
body: My latest bill is higher than usual. Can you explain why the amount changed?

subject: Order still hasn't arrived
body: My order was supposed to arrive three days ago but I still haven't received it. The tracking page hasn't updated either.

subject: Package delayed
body: Hi, tracking says my parcel is delayed in transit. Do you know when I can expect delivery?

subject: Delivery date passed
body: The estimated delivery date was Monday and it's now Thursday. Could you check what happened to my package?

subject: Reset email never arrived
body: I've requested a password reset twice but I haven't received the email. I checked my spam folder too.

subject: Wrong billing amount
body: I was billed $79.99 but my plan should only cost $49.99. Please check whether I've been charged incorrectly.

subject: Tracking hasn't moved
body: My tracking information has been stuck on 'processing at facility' for five days. Is my shipment lost?

subject: I want a refund
body: I'm unhappy with the service and I want a full refund for the last three months. Please process this immediately.

subject: Cancel and refund immediately
body: Cancel my account and refund the payment you took yesterday. I don't want to continue using the service.

subject: Possible security breach
body: I received a login notification from a country I've never visited. I think somebody may have accessed my account.

subject: I am extremely angry about this
body: This is the third time my order has gone missing. Your service is unacceptable and I want to speak to a manager.

subject: Legal complaint regarding my account
body: I believe your company has mishandled my personal data. I need someone from your legal or privacy team to contact me.

subject: Feature request for team accounts
body: Would it be possible to add custom roles and permissions for team members? This would be really useful for our organisation.

subject: App crashes when uploading PDF
body: Every time I upload a PDF larger than around 20 MB the application freezes and closes. I can reproduce this consistently.

subject: Need help changing account email
body: I need to move my account to a different email address, but I can't find an option to change it in settings. Can someone help?
